u2526-tasks-v4-positions.target: 识别三个完整位置短语

Mrs. Smith

u2526-v1-vocab-electric.target: 理解 electric 的本课含义
u2526-v1-vocab-electric.prompt:
electric cooker

u2526-v1-vocab-cooker.target: 理解 cooker 的本课含义
u2526-v1-vocab-cooker.prompt:
cooker

u2526-v1-vocab-room.target: 理解 room 的本课含义
u2526-v1-vocab-room.prompt:
room

u2526-five-g-shared.prompt: 两人都看着房间里唯一的门，补好请求。

u2526-five-g-specific.target: 用位置限定指清具体物品
u2526-five-g-specific.prompt: 房间有几只杯子，其中只有一只在桌上。

u2526-five-g-rank.target: 在给定最高级和序数词前使用the

u2526-five-g-fixed.selection: go to bed · play the piano
optionOrder: go to the bed · play piano

u2526-five-g-there-answers.prompt: 根据两份情况补全简短回答。

u2526-five-g-in-meanings.target: 不把in的不同用法全译成里面
u2526-five-g-in-meanings.prompt: 给三个in词组配上合适的含义。

u2526-types-v1-t04.selection: 桌子上 有 一个瓶子
u2526-types-v1-t04.prompt: 用中文词块说出这句话的意思。

u2526-types-v1-t12.selection: There's a fork on the tin

u2526-five-a-cup-story.prompt: 读到这里，乙接下来应该怎么做？

u2526-types-v1-t06.prompt: 电炉是什么颜色？在厨房哪一边？

u2526-v1-story-it.prompt:
课文说：It is on the right.
这里的 It 指什么？

u2526-v1-exam-picture.prompt:
There is a glass in the cupboard.
The glass is empty.

u2526-v1-exam-boundary.prompt:
There is a cup on the table.

optionOrder: 左边 · 中间 · 右边

___ is blue.

There is a bottle in the refrigerator.

只把 There is 缩写，其他内容保持不变：
There is a clean cup on the table.

optionOrder: go to school · play the piano

Mrs. Smith

u2526-v1-vocab-electric.target: 理解 electric 的本课含义
u2526-v1-vocab-electric.prompt:
electric cooker

u2526-v1-vocab-cooker.prompt:
cooker

u2526-v1-vocab-room.target: 理解 room 的本课含义
u2526-v1-vocab-room.prompt:
room

u2526-five-g-shared.prompt: 两人都看着房间里唯一的门，补好请求。

u2526-five-g-specific.target: 用位置限定指清具体物品

u2526-five-g-there-answers.prompt: 根据两份情况补全简短回答。

u2526-five-g-in-meanings.target: 不把in的不同用法全译成里面

There is a cup on the table.

optionOrder: 左边 · 中间 · 右边

u2526-v1-final-v2-states.prompt: 课文的桌子上，什么是 empty，什么是 clean？

There is an electric cooker in the room.
___ is blue.

u2526-v1-final-v2-where.prompt: 想知道那个瓶子在哪儿，把问句拼出来。

There is a bottle in the refrigerator.

只把 There is 缩写，其他内容保持不变：
There is a clean cup on the table.

u2526-five-e-specific.prompt: 只有一只盒子在地板上，其余都在架子上。

u2526-five-e-earth.prompt: 我们谈论自己生活的地球，补好英文。

optionOrder: go to school · play the piano
go to the school · play piano

unitDialogue.signature: [1,[{"id":"L25-N01","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"Mrs. Smith's kitchen is small.","cn":"史密斯太太的厨房很小。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N02","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"There is a refrigerator in the kitchen.","cn":"厨房里有一台冰箱。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N03","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"The refrigerator is white.","cn":"冰箱是白色的。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N04","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"It is on the right.","cn":"它在右边。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N05","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"There is an electric cooker in the kitchen.","cn":"厨房里有一台电炉。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N06","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"The cooker is blue.","cn":"电炉是蓝色的。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N07","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"It is on the left.","cn":"它在左边。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N08","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"There is a table in the middle of the room.","cn":"房间的中间有一张桌子。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N09","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"There is a bottle on the table.","cn":"桌子上有一个瓶子。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N10","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"The bottle is empty.","cn":"瓶子是空的。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N11","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"There is a cup on the table, too.","cn":"桌子上还有一个杯子。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"},{"id":"L25-N12","person":"narrator","who":"narration","text":"The cup is clean.","cn":"杯子很干净。","source":"《新概念英语智慧版1》纸页50–53（PDF83–86）；Lesson25原文"}]]
